title: Wade Boggs 1990 Topps Woolworth #8 Boston Red Sox Baseball Card, 3rd Base
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a vintage 1990 Topps Woolworth #8 Boston Red Sox baseball card featuring Wade Boggs, a former Major League Baseball player and Hall of Famer. The card is made of card stock and has a standard thickness. It is an original, not a licensed reprint. 

The card is part of the Baseball Highlights series and is serial numbered and short printed, making it a valuable addition to any collection. It has been authenticated by the Certified Guaranty Company (CGC) and is in excellent shape. This card is a must-have for any Boston Red Sox or Wade Boggs fan and is a great investment opportunity.
